name: session-cookie
title: Revocable browser sessions with host cookies and strict mutation origins
description: Adds HMAC-authenticated browser cookies backed by D1 sessions, immediate logout and revoke-all, expiry cleanup, and Hono middleware that rejects unsafe requests without a same-origin Origin header.
author: Coop <coop@xavalabs.com>

params.name: tablePrefix
params.description: SQL table prefix to avoid conflicts.

params.name: cookieName
params.description: Cookie suffix; HTTPS uses __Host- and loopback HTTP uses dev_.

secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: At least 32 random characters used for HMAC session signatures. Rotation signs out all browsers.

routes.description: Revoke current session and clear its cookie.
Revoke every session belonging to the current owner.

agent.summary: Adds HMAC-authenticated browser cookies backed by D1 sessions, immediate logout and revoke-all, expiry cleanup, and Hono middleware that rejects unsafe requests without a same-origin Origin header.
when_to_use: Revocable browser sessions with host cookies and strict mutation origins
when_not_to_use: No login provider, account schema, idle timeout or cross-site cookies. Sessions read D1 on every request. Cookie mutations require a same-origin Origin header; non-browser clients should use bearer auth. Owner suspension/deletion must revoke sessions in the host application.

adapt.title: Configure the secret
adapt.do: Set SESSION_SECRET to at least 32 random characters using local secret configuration and the deployment secret store.
adapt.check: Session creation succeeds with the configured secret.

adapt.title: Issue only after verified sign-in
adapt.do: After validating the login proof and its own CSRF/OAuth state, call createSession(env, trustedMemberId, request) and append its setCookie to the response. Never accept an owner id directly from the request body.
adapt.check: A successful sign-in creates a fresh session cookie; invalid sign-in creates none.

adapt.title: Mount routes and protect cookie-authenticated APIs
adapt.do: Mount sessionRoutes() at {{kit.routePrefix}}; apply requireSession to other cookie-authenticated routes. Both expect DB and SESSION_SECRET bindings.
adapt.check: Unauthenticated requests return 401; writes without the exact same-origin Origin return 403.

adapt.title: Revoke on account removal and schedule cleanup
adapt.do: Call revokeOwnerSessions on account disable/delete and cleanupSessions from an awaited scheduled handler. Authenticate disabled members in host middleware when appropriate.
adapt.check: A disabled account cannot keep using a previously issued session.

agent.author_notes: No login provider, account schema, idle timeout or cross-site cookies. Sessions read D1 on every request. Cookie mutations require a same-origin Origin header; non-browser clients should use bearer auth. Owner suspension/deletion must revoke sessions in the host application.
